title: Ki-Rin Hair
summary: Combine three Ki-Rin Hairs to make Sublimate of Ki-Rin Hair, then mix with any Ash to brew Supreme Healing.

fields.Extraction: 3 × Ki-Rin Hair yields 1 Sublimate of Ki-Rin Hair.
fields.Potion recipe: Sublimate of Ki-Rin Hair plus any Ash yields Potion of Supreme Healing.
fields.Acquisition: Can appear at traders such as Blurg and Derryth Bonecloak in the Myconid Colony after reaching level 6.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
